_meta.notes: WORST SCAN IN THE CHUNK: a degraded fax (fax header 01/10/2011) with a heavy black smear over the left half of page 1 and very loose handwriting. Re-rendered page 2 at 300 and 600 dpi and cropped every cell; Line 2 Column A, Line 5 and Line 7 Column A remain genuinely unreadable (each is written but the individual digits cannot be resolved) and are recorded as null rather than guessed. Line 3 (1897) matches the October interim's Line 7 (1,897), which corroborates that reading. Note this is a Final/Dissolution report yet Line 7 is plainly NOT zero (a 3-digit figure is written). Worth a human's eyes.

contributions.detail: NOT COMPARABLE AS PRINTED, and the itemized figure is a FLOOR. Two separate facts. (1) Schedule A's own printed TOTAL is 27,438 - the same figure the Summary Page carries in COLUMN B (aggregate to date) - so this schedule lists the WHOLE CYCLE while Column A ($868) is the final period only; the last row (11/6/10, 868) is the only in-period row and equals Column A exactly. (2) Five of the seven amounts are ghost-thin on this degraded fax and were left BLANK rather than guessed, so the 1,043.00 quoted here is only the two legible amounts (175 + 868) and is a floor. My best reads of the five illegible amounts sum to 26,450 where the schedule's own total requires 26,395 - proof at least one of them is misread, which is why none were kept.

expenditures.detail: The stated Summary line 2 was left null by the totals wave (illegible on this degraded fax), so there is no anchor to reconcile against. The schedule's OWN identity does close: the 10 transcribed rows sum to exactly 27,438 = the printed page subtotal = the printed total. That 27,438 is the aggregate-to-date figure (Summary Column B), not the period figure.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 (Schedule B) rows 27,438 = printed subtotal 27,438 = printed total - GATE CLOSES, and it is what settled one disputed amount: my independent reads summed to 27,428, and the single row whose glyph was ambiguous between 485 and 495 is 495 by the identity (document arithmetic outranking the glyph re-read). p4 (Schedule A): the printed SUBTOTAL cell is blank and the printed TOTAL is 27,438; the two legible rows plus five unreadable ones cannot be gated - NO GATE.

itemized.notes: DEGRADED FAX (received 01/10/2011, WAFCO header) with a black smear down the left edge of p3 and ghost-thin pencil throughout. THREE things a human should know. (1) PAGE ORDER IS REVERSED: p3 is Schedule B and p4 is Schedule A. (2) SYSTEMATIC COLUMN OFFSET, screened and resolved: on BOTH schedule pages the right-hand block (occupation/purpose + amount) is written ONE ROW BELOW its left-hand block (date + name). I resolved the offset rather than withholding because five independent semantic pairings confirm it - Utah Rep Party/'Pol Party', Dalton Hyde LLC/'Hyde Electric Co.', HW Cattle Co/'Farming Ranching', Steve Harmsen/'Ind', and above all the Mar/10 175 pair that appears identically on both schedules (the county filing fee paid and the candidate money that funded it). Every row here is emitted on that alignment; if the alignment is wrong, every occupation and amount is off by one. (3) The schedules are CUMULATIVE for the cycle (they total to the Summary's Column B aggregate) while Column A reports only the final period - do not compare the row sums to stated_c/stated_e. Schedule A/B header boxes both read 'HARMSEN' / '10/26/10' though the filing is the Final-Dissolution faxed in January 2011.
